description: Home of the kerjaan plugin — a markdown-only ticket tracker that lives inside your repo.

plugins.name: kerjaan
plugins.description: A ticket tracker that is nothing but markdown files inside a repo. Ships the board skill, the worker, reviewer and queue planner agents, and the hooks that have the foreman dispatch the reviewer once a ticket is in review and write a handoff before its context is summarized.
